messages.author: 1ff63ac4948de366
messages.subject: digest dependency?
parts:
Hi Henrik.

Just tried the full 'aroma.affymetrix' install script on a fresh R 2.7 and
'aroma.core' failed because it depends on the 'digest' package. I
manually installed the 'digest' package from CRAN, reran and it worked no
problem.

Thought you should know.

Cheers,
Mark

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] digest dependency?
parts:
Strange, hbInstall("aroma.affymetrix") should install 'digest' (at the
same time as 'RColorBrewer') from CRAN. I leave this as aa one-time
problem right now. Maybe there was a CRAN problem when you tried?
Platform?

/Henrik
